claims.text: Places Ranked by Women Affected by Anemia
claims.support: Global Health Observatory Data Repository/World Health Statistics, World Health Organization (WHO), 2023, 188 mapped countries and territories with data
Global Health Observatory Data Repository/World Health Statistics, World Health Organization (WHO), 2023

claims.text: Ranking countries and territories by the share of women of reproductive age affected by anemia, from high-income nations to the world's highest rates.
claims.support: Prevalence of anemia among women of reproductive age refers to the combined prevalence of both non-pregnant with haemoglobin levels below 12 g/dL and pregnant women with haemoglobin levels below 11 g/dL.

claims.text: Even in Australia, 11.1% of women have anemia. In India, it's 53.7%.
Wealthy nations aren't immune: the UK has 13.6%, and the USA has 15%.
The climb steepens: Benin has 50%, Ivory Coast 51.4%, Mauritania 54.5%, and Mali 56.5%.
At number 1, Gabon has 59.9%, the world's highest. That is 4 times what the USA has.
claims.support: Gabon: 59.9% (rank 1), United States: 15.0% (59.9 is approximately 4 times 15.0)

claims.text: How common is anemia among women in your country?
claims.support: Indicator SH.ANM.ALLW.ZS measures the prevalence of anemia among women of reproductive age.
